reviews.comment: 1 LOW blocker: existsSync guard placed before the already-running early-return — a running project whose folder is transiently gone would 404 instead of routing to its live url; move the guard just before the spawn. Otherwise correct + tested (Phase 1 crash fix, Phase 2 reregister status-push). Non-blocking: Phase 2 needs a live smoke after it ships.

fix.comment: Fixed blocker 1: moved the existsSync guard to after the already-running/starting early-returns (only the spawn path is gated now). A live project routes to its url before the folder check. 363/363 tests.
